item.title: enae.es: 71. The gap: form labels.
item.description:
Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 20 form controls have no label.
The lesson for every team: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

item.title: Apache.org runs without descriptions.
item.description:
Preloaded HSTS, a security.txt, a content security policy, and Core Web Vitals that pass for real visitors. But none of the 20 pages analyzed, the home page included, has a meta description.
The lesson for every team: Give each page a description of about 150 characters. Search and AI answers quote it when they introduce you.
One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=apache
#SEO #MetaDescription #OpenSource #QA #QAlab

item.title: The Linux Foundation never states a language.
item.description:
A sitemap, one-year HSTS, framing limited to its own origin, and no broken links among the pages analyzed. But the <html> tag has no lang attribute, so screen readers guess which voice to use.
The lesson for every team: Add lang="en" to the html tag in the site template. One attribute fixes every page at once.
One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=linuxfoundation
#Accessibility #A11y #i18n #QA #QAlab

item.title: GitHub Docs sets no canonical link.
item.description:
A content security policy that starts from default-src 'none', HSTS, nosniff, and framing limited to its own origin. But none of the 20 pages analyzed has a canonical link, so URL variants compete in search.
The lesson for every team: Add a self-referencing canonical to every docs page. Versioned and translated docs need it most.
One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=githubdocs
#SEO #Canonical #Docs #QA #QAlab

item.title: Stripe Docs skips the main landmark.
item.description:
Preloaded HSTS, a content security policy, and a skip link to the content. But none of the 20 pages analyzed marks that content with a <main> landmark, which screen-reader users jump to directly.
The lesson for every team: Wrap the primary content in one <main> element. Screen readers list it as a landmark you can jump to.
One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict. How the review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-100-2026-11&utm_content=stripedocs
